page.notes: Run-in italic-free catchphrases such as "Os de ossibus meis)", "Et caro de carne mea)", "Haec vocabitur virago)" and "Eo quod de viro..." are set inline in the text block, not in a margin, so they are transcribed as text. Long s is written as plain s (e.g. "ofsibus" as "ossibus", "fumpta" as "sumpta"); u/v and i/j are normalised. The Greek word ἀνδρίς and the Hebrew words אִישׁ and אִשָּׁה are read from a small, blurred print and should be checked against the scan. "Euam" is read as "E-vam" across the line break.
